meta.title: Ruin DLL Injector — Modern Rust-based DLL Injection
meta.description: A modern, lightweight injector built with Rust and egui. Auto-injection, process filtering, UWP detection, real-time logging.

hero.title: DLL injection,
hero.subtitle: A modern, lightweight injector built with Rust and egui. Auto-injection, process filtering, UWP detection, real-time logging — all in one clean interface.

features.label: Capabilities
features.title: Built for people who inject DLLs daily.
features.subtitle: No bloat. No complexity. Just the features that matter when you're working with custom DLLs in Minecraft Bedrock Edition or any Windows application.

autoInjection.title: Auto-injection
autoInjection.description: Enable auto-inject and Ruin watches for your target process. The moment it spawns, your DLL is loaded. Settings persist between sessions.

processBrowser.title: Process browser
processBrowser.description: Live process enumeration with instant search filtering. See PID, name, and UWP status at a glance. No more scrolling through Task Manager.

architectureGuard.title: Architecture guard
architectureGuard.description: 32-bit and 64-bit validation happens before injection. No more silent failures from mismatched binaries.

uwpDetection.title: UWP detection
uwpDetection.description: Automatically flags Universal Windows Platform apps and blocks injection into protected processes. Clear warnings, no guesswork.

realtimeLogging.title: Real-time logging
realtimeLogging.description: Every action is logged with timestamps and context. Fade-in animations make new entries easy to spot at a glance.

errorDiagnostics.title: Error diagnostics
errorDiagnostics.description: Actionable error messages tell you exactly what went wrong — architecture mismatch, permission issues, DLL load failure — and what to do about it.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.title: Six steps. Nothing extra.
workflow.subtitle: The full injection pipeline, from process discovery to cleanup. Every step uses standard Windows APIs with proper resource management.

processDiscovery.title: Process discovery
processDiscovery.description: Enumerates all running processes via CreateToolhelp32Snapshot and iterates with Process32First/Process32Next. Instant search filtering by name.

uwpDetectionStep.title: UWP detection
uwpDetectionStep.description: Checks WindowsApps/AppPackages directories and resolves the full image path via QueryFullProcessImageNameW. Protected apps are flagged before you can select them.

architectureCheck.title: Architecture check
architectureCheck.description: Validates bitness match between injector (cfg(target_pointer_width)) and target (IsWow64Process). Prevents 32/64-bit mismatch failures.

memoryAllocation.title: Memory allocation & write
memoryAllocation.description: VirtualAllocEx allocates writable memory in the target process. Your DLL path is written as UTF-16 via WriteProcessMemory, validated against MAX_PATH_LENGTH.

remoteThread.title: Remote thread creation
remoteThread.description: CreateRemoteThread launches LoadLibraryW in the target address space. A 10-second timeout waits for completion, then checks the exit code.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: VirtualFreeEx releases allocated memory. CloseHandle releases all handles. RAII patterns ensure nothing leaks, even on error paths.

tech.label: Stack
tech.title: Rust, from top to bottom.
tech.subtitle: Zero dependencies on C/C++ runtimes. Memory-safe by construction. Every component chosen for correctness, not convenience.

rust.name: Rust 2021
rust.description: The entire codebase. Memory safety without a garbage collector. Zero compiler warnings, zero clippy warnings.

egui.name: egui 0.27
egui.description: Immediate-mode GUI framework. Custom animation system with Fade, Scale, Slide, and Pulse types built on an Animatable trait.

windowsRs.name: windows-rs 0.54
windowsRs.description: Raw Windows API bindings. CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, VirtualAllocEx, CreateRemoteThread — all called directly, no wrappers.

serdeDirs.name: serde + dirs
serdeDirs.description: Atomic config writes via temp-file-then-rename. Thread-safe persistence. Graceful fallback on first launch.
